an4.193:9.4: “A contented individual, not overcome by greed, doesn’t kill living creatures, steal, commit adultery, lie, or encourage others to do the same. Is that for their lasting welfare and happiness?”
an4.193:10.1: “What do you think, Bhaddiya, does non-hatred … or non-delusion … or non-aggression come up in a person for their welfare or harm?”
an4.193:13.7: Then you won’t act out of delusion by way of body, speech, or mind.
an4.193:13.9: Then you won’t act out of aggression by way of body, speech, or mind.’”
an4.193:15.11: If all the brahmins … peasants … menials were to be converted by this, it would be for their lasting welfare and happiness.”
an4.193:16.3: If all the brahmins … peasants … menials were to be converted by this, for giving up unskillful qualities and embracing skillful qualities, it would be for their lasting welfare and happiness.
